From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft case study: Orchid Health — draft for fact-check and quote

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. As promised, attached is draft v2 of the Orchid Health case write-up. The doc focuses on the production reliability gains you saw after switching to our Dedicated tier and the 35% average token-cost reduction from batching + KV prefix caching.

Two asks for your team:
- Quick factual passback on the numbers in section 2 (implementation timeline, latency figures, cost savings).
- Approval (or redlines) on the quote attributed to Tom in the call (page 4).

I'm keeping this short — Marissa is cc'd and will coordinate any editorial updates. If it's easier, we can hop on a 20-minute call to walk through edits; otherwise, a reply with inline comments in Google Drive works fine.

Attachments: orchid_case_draft_v2.docx, redwood_style_guide.pdf

Best,
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://cal.redwood.ai/nikhil

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@orchidhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft case study: Orchid Health — draft for fact-check and quote

Hi Nikhil — thanks for sending. Tom and I read through v2 and left inline comments in the Drive doc (link above). High-level notes:
- The 35% number looks right as a 90-day average, but please change the language to "up to 35% cost reduction on average for high-concurrency routes" — we want to avoid implying that all workloads saw the same reduction.
- Latency: our P95 after the go-live was 180ms for search queries (not 150ms) — please update section 2.1.
- Timeline: the onboarding took 5 weeks from kickoff to production, not 4 weeks.
- Quote: Tom is fine with the sentiment but wants a shorter sentence: "Redwood gave us predictable latency and saved our team engineering cycles on serving operations."

We can sign off on publication once those factual edits and the quote wording are in.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Liu
Head of Product Ops | Orchid Health
